units.lyric_anchor: gentle line of the chorus (43.64-50.48) - her world, not the plane
units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A medium shot from a low angle; the camera holds a locked-off tripod frame, everything still except the living light and air.
